CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

Councilmember Ramirez commented on the various Parks and Recreation programs
taking place; thanked City staff for all they do; encouraged residents to attend the summer
concert series and recreation programs throughout the summer; and reported on his
attendance at the ice cream Social held at the Hargitt House Museum. Councilmember
Ayala encouraged Public Safety and Los Angeles County Sheriffs to be more vigilant with
the enforcement of illegal fireworks. Vice Mayor Rios welcomed all in attendance;
thanked residents for their continued participation within the community and encouraged
them to stay engaged and informed; and thanked City staff for their hard work. Mayor
Valencia wished all fathers a happy belated Father’s Day; welcomed dignitaries in
attendance; reported on her attendance at the Gateway Cities Council of Governments
Board of Directors Meeting, where they discussed various topics such as homelessness,
and the Los Angeles Metro line extension to the airport; reported on her attendance at
the Norwalk Lions Club event and the Chamber of Commerce 100 Years Diamond Gala
Dinner; announced a Meet the Mayor event being held at Mr. Rosewoods June 21 at 4:30
p.m.; and invited all to attend the City’s Independence Day event on July 1.
